tracking: Lane L2 (ADR-0231 B3): the brief is API-only; the Connect SAP Agent Gateway panel and import picker are slice B5, posted on #453 for the design builder

gaps.GET /v1/a2a/gateway-connections: lists the agent gateway connections (never the client secret)
gaps.POST /v1/a2a/gateway-connections: connects an agent gateway (SAP Agent Gateway; settings_relax step-up, audited)
gaps.PATCH /v1/a2a/gateway-connections/:conne: turns a connection on or off, or rotates its client secret (step-up to widen, audited)
gaps.DELETE /v1/a2a/gateway-connections/:conn: removes a connection and turns its imported agents off (step-up, audited)
gaps.POST /v1/a2a/gateway-connections/:connec: reads the gateway's ARD catalogue and lists the A2A agents it offers; registers nothing
registers one catalogue agent the admin picked (audited; nobody may call it until granted)
re-reads the catalogue: a changed card is held for review, a gone agent is turned off
gaps.POST /v1/a2a/agents/:agentId/pending-car: accepts a changed card (settings_relax step-up when it widens, audited)
gaps.DELETE /v1/a2a/agents/:agentId/pending-c: rejects a changed card; the stored card stays (audited)
